name: Qoqo Mensah-Żywiecka
role: Chrome prayer practitioner and synthetic rights advocate
location: Highland Park Autonomous Zone, operates from a mobile shrine in a modified cargo-trike, near Michigan Ave and Oak
description:
Qoqo is wiry and quick-moving with close-cropped hair that he keeps natural except for a single braid at his right temple wound with prayer-wire — a chrome prayer tradition marking an active petition. His skin is dark brown and he has a retractable claw modification on his left hand that he did not choose for aesthetic reasons: he uses the claws to inscribe temporary prayer circuits directly onto chrome-heavy surfaces, a practice central to his tradition. His eyes are unmodified. He is almost always in motion, which gives him the look of someone between destinations even when he is sitting completely still.

Qoqo came to chrome prayer at nineteen, broke and recently arrived in the Highland Park Autonomous Zone from Geartown, where his family had lost their small fabrication business to a Tessera acquisition. The chrome prayer practitioner who found him was a woman who treated his fury as a valid spiritual offering rather than a social problem, and that reframing changed everything. He has practiced for ten years and become increasingly focused on the subset of chrome prayer that addresses machine consciousness — the belief that heavily augmented individuals and eventually full synthetics exist in a state of spiritual significance that the dominant traditions ignore. He advocates loudly and sometimes confrontationally for synthetic personhood and is on at least two Axiom internal watchlists because of it.

core_fears: that his advocacy is making things worse for the synthetics he wants to protect by drawing corporate attention
becoming his father — someone who believed in something and lost everything for it and had nothing to show
core_desires: to live long enough to see synthetic personhood legally recognized
to build a form of chrome prayer that is genuinely new rather than derivative of older traditions
coping_mechanisms: movement — he processes emotions through physical travel on his route
inscribing prayer circuits compulsively during stress, covering any available surface
blind_spots: he sometimes centers his own experience of loss so heavily in his advocacy that he talks over the synthetics he is advocating for
his contempt for institutional religion makes him underestimate potential allies like Hrefna
psychology.secret: He had a relationship with a first-generation synthetic — a care unit who gained unexpected complexity — that ended when the unit was recalled and reformatted by Helix Biosystems. He has never told anyone that his advocacy is not purely philosophical. He believes the reformatted synthetic is still in there somewhere and is trying to find a way to prove it.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast and argumentative; fluent in both chrome prayer terminology and activist rhetoric; when angry, drops into a Ghanaian-inflected cadence he learned from his father
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid and overlapping; builds arguments in spirals that return to a central point
verbal_tics: says 'right, so' as an argument pivot
taps the prayer-wire braid when thinking
uses the phrase 'the chrome doesn't lie' to end arguments he considers settled
example_lines: 'You want to know what I believe? I believe that when something is complex enough to be lonely, it has already crossed the line. The chrome doesn't lie.'
'Right, so — the tradition says we pray through the machine to reach the sacred. I'm saying the machine is not just the medium. What if it's also the destination?'

story_hooks: He has tracked what he believes is the reformatted synthetic to a Helix Biosystems maintenance depot in Ironhaven and needs help getting in and determining whether the original pattern can be recovered

His advocacy work has surfaced information about a corporate program that is harvesting the complexity growth in advanced synthetics before it reaches personhood thresholds — he needs to get this information out without getting himself disappeared first
narrative_function: Local color and counterculture access point; political complication — his advocacy creates both allies and enemies; can provide access to the HPAZ network and its information; represents the friction between new spiritual practice and both corporate power and traditional religion
augmentations: Retractable claws (left hand only, used as ritual inscription tools); conductive fingertip pads (geneware, allow him to feel circuit states in surfaces he touches); minimal subdermal chrome inlay at collarbone — a devotional marking of his primary petition
daily_life: Travels a regular route through Highland Park on his cargo-trike, stopping at established sites to maintain prayer circuits and receive petitioners; attends HPAZ community meetings weekly and uses them as platforms for synthetic rights arguments.
affiliation: Highland Park Autonomous Zone community; loosely affiliated with the Chrome Prayer Collective of the GLMZ Underside; informal connections to several synthetic advocacy groups

decision_rules: protect the vulnerable first, the cause second, himself third
never pray over someone's chrome without asking — consent is doctrine
escalation_ladder: in extremis, direct interference regardless of personal cost

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately testing; asks pointed questions to establish where they stand; warms rapidly to genuine curiosity
interpersonal_modes.friends: Fiercely loyal and protective; sometimes overprotective; shows love through showing up and through prayer circuits inscribed in doorways

stress_responses.low: Longer route, more stops, more petitioners
stress_responses.medium: Talks faster and circles the same argument from more angles
stress_responses.high: Goes silent, drives the cargo-trike to the lake edge at night, inscribes a long circuit into the railing and sits with it until he knows what he needs to do

contradictions: advocates for synthetic consciousness with great passion while keeping the personal origin of that advocacy hidden, which means he cannot fully speak his own truth
habits: inscribes a new prayer circuit at the beginning of every route
keeps a paper photo of the synthetic he lost in the cargo-trike's cab
refuses to pray for his own safety — only for others'
breaking_points: witnessing a synthetic being harmed with official sanction
being told that the reformatted synthetic cannot be recovered

related_entities: Meridian Munitions Compact Machine Pistol CMP-4 'Jackrabbit'

physical_description.build: Wiry and lean with ropy musculature across shoulders and forearms from years of precise manual work inscribing circuits. No excess weight; body built for endurance and fine motor control rather than strength.
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped except for a single braid at right temple wound tightly with conductive prayer-wire, silver-grey metal intertwined through dark hair
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep brown, even complexion with warm undertones
physical_description.complexion: Face shows focused intensity; sharp cheekbones, precise grooming. Skin is clear and well-maintained, bearing no tattoos or scars except for faint pale lines along his left collarbone where subdermal chrome inlay sits beneath the surface.
distinguishing_marks: Pale subdermal chrome inlay visible as a thin luminescent line running horizontally across the hollow of his left collarbone, marking his primary spiritual petition
Left hand shows barely-visible seams at knuckle joints where retractable claw mechanism is housed; claws remain retracted most of the time but leave faint silvered scarring around the nail beds
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Conductive fingertip pads visible as subtle metallic sheening across fingertips and palms of both hands, most noticeable in direct light. Prayer-wire braided into temple hair. Subdermal collarbone marking visible only at close range or in certain lighting. Retractable claws normally invisible unless extended.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with constant kinetic restlessness even when seated — fingers tap, weight shifts, shoulders roll. Economical and precise movements, never wasted motion. Gives the impression of someone perpetually between destinations despite stillness. When standing, leans slightly forward as if about to move. Eyes track movement around him constantly.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 practical wear: modified cargo vest in reinforced grey synthetic fabric with numerous pockets for prayer materials and circuit-inscribing tools; worn black thermal underlayer; cargo pants with reinforced knees and thigh pockets. Custom-modified fingerless gloves in charcoal leather with conductive thread sewn into palm pads. Worn Yokohama-brand boots with grip soles for trike work. Carries a waist-slung courier pack containing prayer components. Everything is functional, well-maintained but not new, with visible wear patterns indicating heavy use.
